claims.answer: WA PI kernel owns orchestration and product delegate tool. Role prompts/model/tool whitelists are configurations over Pi; product starts/resumes worker instances and collects results. Exact peer-to-peer worker messaging is not established; the role relationship web is not treated as an independent messaging guarantee. Aggregates worker text plus completed/failed/interrupted status, transcript path, elapsed time and usage into parent tool result and UI details. Full transcript/resume is documented.

sources.title: WA PI Agent readme
sources.locator: README.md §§Key features; Architecture; Roadmap; FAQ; Up and running
sources.finding: Describes Pi RPC subprocess sessions, desktop/local browser interfaces, roles/delegation, WeCom incoming messages, cron scheduling, custom model providers, local data, artifact publishing and MIT/free client. Other IM channel names are reserved/future, not shipped adapters.

sources.title: WA PI Agent rpc-client
sources.finding: Production spawn uses configured runtime with the actual Pi Coding Agent CLI path and --mode rpc plus session args, cwd and inherited/configured environment. Pi package entrypoint is resolved from @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent; not an OpenCode model-provider alias.

sources.title: WA PI Agent packages-kernel-src-agent-manager-ts
sources.locator: AgentManager module contract lines 1–10, per-session handle map and spawn path around line 1644
sources.finding: Kernel maintains one Pi RPC subprocess per WA PI session, owning lifecycle, queues and event/UI routing. Independent subprocess does not imply a container or restricted filesystem.

sources.title: WA PI Agent packages-kernel-src-delegate-tool-ts
sources.locator: delegate execute lines 408–458, runWithConcurrency lines 552+ and results map lines 895–954
sources.finding: Product delegate tool validates task array, starts/resumes subagent instances through its configured spawn function, executes with bounded concurrency, and returns aggregated per-worker status/result text, transcript paths and usage; full details drive inspectable UI.

sources.title: WA PI Agent packages-kernel-src-scheduler-ts
sources.locator: toCronExpression lines 10–50; register Bun.cron lines 152+; runTaskNow and interrupted-run reconciliation lines 188–246
sources.finding: Product-owned local Bun.cron dispatcher converts minute/hourly/daily/weekdays/weekly/monthly/custom schedules using host local time, records running executions and reconciles abandoned running records as interrupted after restart. No managed cloud or offline catch-up guarantee established.

sources.title: WA PI Agent packages-kernel-assets-scheduled-tasks-readme-md
sources.locator: Task directory contract and frontmatter example; schedules and common operations
sources.finding: Per-project tasks/<id>.md stores schedule/role/enabled/frontmatter plus instruction body; logs/<id>.log appends run status/details. Bundled cron-task.ts management CLI adds/lists/runs/disables tasks; saved Markdown hot reloads.

sources.title: WA PI Agent packages-frontend-src-components-blocks-editdiffview-tsx
sources.finding: Conversation diff renderer parses actual Pi details.diff text, shows old/new line numbers, add/delete markers and renderCode(row) content with optional intra-line highlights. This is inspected UI implementation, not a filename/count-only API response. No populated public screenshot of this view established.

sources.title: WA PI Agent packages-kernel-src-git-service-ts
sources.finding: Local Git service serializes mutating operations and gitPull invokes git pull --autostash --no-edit with timeout; this narrow upstream pull capability does not establish a PR-merge review workflow or protected-branch approval.
